name: Thalanaar Delivery
summary: At the Woodpaw camps, a parcel for Thalanaar still waits for its recipient. The hand-written name may guide you there.

sections.title: A Parcel Gone Astray
sections.body: You find goods for Thalanaar in the Woodpaw gnoll camps. The small way-station lies in southeastern Feralas. A hand-written name on the parcel points you toward the person expecting the goods: Falfindel Waywarder.

sections.title: Word at the Way-station
sections.body: Falfindel Waywarder praises Elune as the shipment from Feathermoon Stronghold arrives at last. Falfindel fears Raschal, the usual courier, has met with ill fate. The Woodpaw have grown agitated over something to their south, and Falfindel suspects Raschal fell to the wilds there. Take care as you travel.

faq.answer: Falfindel Waywarder is the hand-written name on the parcel. Falfindel is the person you are to find in Thalanaar.
Thalanaar is a small way-station in southeastern Feralas. That is where the parcel was meant to go.

aliases: where did the parcel come from
faq.answer: You found the parcel in the Woodpaw gnoll camps.
The courier's fate is unknown. The delivery remains unfinished, and the parcel still needs to reach Thalanaar.
